english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who is not honest or for dishonest conduct.

exampleSentences.english: They lie all the time; they’re really dishonest.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢成日講大話，真係唔老實。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 daai6 waa6 zan1 hai6 m4 lou5 sat6

english.note: Use this of a person who lies or behaves dishonestly, rather than of a merely incorrect statement.

exampleSentences.english: You’re being false—you clearly saw it but said you didn’t.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你唔老實，明明見到都話冇見到。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 m4 lou5 sat6 ming4 ming4 gin3 dou2 dou1 waa6 mou5 gin3 dou2
